sub_service: Garbage/sanitation complaint via Ranchi Municipal Corporation's Smart Ranchi 24x7 connect center
department: Ranchi Municipal Corporation (RMC) -- Smart Ranchi Connect Center
description: Ranchi Municipal Corporation's own website (ranchimunicipal.com) links directly to 'RMC Connect Center Smart Ranchi 24x7' (smartranchi.in) as its grievance portal -- fetched directly. It offers 4 real, confirmed intake channels: an online complaint form, a 24x7 phone line (1800-570-1235), WhatsApp (+91 8141231235, message 'Hi' to start), and email (support@smartranchi.in), plus a mobile app. The page states complaints are acknowledged via SMS/email/app notification/printed receipt and that 'each complaint will be treated within the stipulated time,' but no numeric SLA is given for any category. Also confirmed via the district government's own site (ranchi.nic.in/public-utility/ranchi-municipal-corporation/), which independently publishes RMC's real phone number (+91-651-2211215).
procedure: File online via the Smart Ranchi portal's complaint registration link, call 1800-570-1235 (24x7), WhatsApp 'Hi' to +91 8141231235, or email support@smartranchi.in; the source page offers no category-specific routing beyond these general channels.
sla: SLA NOT FOUND for waste & sanitation complaints specifically -- the page states a general commitment to timely handling ('each complaint will be treated within the stipulated time') but no numeric figure is published.

contact_information: Toll-free: 1800-570-1235 (24x7). WhatsApp: +91 8141231235. Email: support@smartranchi.in. RMC direct phone (per ranchi.nic.in): +91-651-2211215.
